Senses.Explanation: To raise a bone heap on level ground is to manufacture obstruction where the ground was clear. Fushan Fayuan gives it as an answer about the ancestor’s coming, while Eryin Mi and Baizhang Yiqi apply the image to unnecessary contrivance in disciplined conduct and teaching. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and controls duplicate recensions at the deployment-family level.
